title: Compactness of the rank-one derived module
statement: For any ring S in universe w, with the indicated derived category and coproducts, the explicit object P = (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of S (ULift.{vH} S)) is compact.

proof.text: Introduce the family in the definition of IsCompactObject and pair comparison injectivity (proved using coproduct projections) with comparison surjectivity (the remaining rank-one cohomology calculation).

proof_origin.place: rank-one compactness via injectivity and surjectivity

lean.statement:
theorem derivedModule_rankOne_compact
    {S : Type w} [Ring S]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{max w vH} (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S)]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vH} (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S))] :
    IsCompactObject
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S) 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of S (ULift.{vH} S)))
